title: family-quantifier-swap
claims: There is one NP family with C/n tending to infinity.

proof_chunks: Suppose for each M there exists some eligible family F_M with liminf C(F_M)/n>=M. Choose a new family whenever M increases. This immediately gives one fixed family whose ratio tends to infinity. No uniform diagonal construction or NP argument is supplied.
